fixes_live_proof.POINTS_SCALING_FACTOR: exposed getter exists + returns 1e12 for 18-dec tokens (tokenDecimals>=12 branch) — function absent in the pre-fix hardcoded version
fixes_live_proof.MIN_STAKE_AMOUNT: exposed getter exists (1e12) — absent pre-fix; unstake() enforces remainingAmount>=MIN_STAKE_AMOUNT
fixes_live_proof.calculateLockMultiplier(365d): 4121320343559501001 (4.1213x, fractional preserved — NOT truncated to 4) => div-before-mul fixed

reward_pools.note: remaining = getRewardTokens totalDeposited - totalClaimed, priced with DefiLlama; unpriced project tokens excluded. All claimable only by stakers pro-rata (H-O).

residuals.stake_unstake_truncation: points=floor(amount/POINTS_SCALING_FACTOR) both ways; floor subadditivity lets a user retain ~1 extra point per partial unstake. Bounded to 1 point/tx by MIN_STAKE_AMOUNT; each point worth rewardPool/totalPoints (~1e-12 USD given totalPoints ~1e15) => economically worthless.
residuals.burn_unchecked_transfer: burn() uses stakingToken.transfer(DEAD_WALLET, amount) without checking the bool return; only relevant if a live moat's staking token returns false without reverting (none identified).
residuals.unallocated_when_totalPoints_zero: if a moat has totalPoints==0 and admin deposits rewards, the first staker's next updatePool distributes them to that staker; immaterial (rewards are admin-funded and small).
residuals.privileged: factory owner is a single EOA (can change adminWallet/feeReceiver/usdcToken/deploymentFee); adminWallet 0x7fa527... is admin of every moat + moatManager; all setters/depositRewards/emergency* are onlyAdmin/onlyMoatManager.

verdict: E-U ~$0 (high). Rewards are admin-funded and total ~$2.2k priced; staked principal is per-user withdrawable (H-O); no unprivileged path moves value to an attacker.
